clips.title: The story
paras: In western Tirisfal Glades, Scarlet Crusaders hold a fortified scout tower beside Solliden Farmstead. It marks the Crusade's westernmost position in all of Lordaeron, far from its main bastions and deep in hostile Forsaken territory.

A stone tower rises in the western Tirisfal hills, just north of Deathknell. The Scarlet garrison here marks the farthest reach of the Crusade's power in Lordaeron. Its soldiers work with the surviving human laborers at Solliden Farmstead, trying to hold back the encroaching undead. Lookouts watch the nearby pumpkin fields and forest paths for Scourge fiends and patrols from the Undercity.

The western frontier leaves the crusaders in a perilous position. Their main strongholds lie at the Scarlet Monastery and far to the east at Tyr's Hand, with no swift reinforcements likely if an attack breaches the palisade. Should Forsaken forces massing across Tirisfal lay siege, the garrison must hold the tower alone or face annihilation before help can arrive.
